scope: read-only weather visuals; no simulation authority

stateOwnership.determinism: same input snapshot + quality + seed produces same frame

weatherContinuum.selection: anchors initialize values only; every effect consumes continuous parameters after initialization
weatherContinuum.interpolation: clamped linear input with per-asset smoothstep activation; no enum-only visual branch

shutdownPaths.globalOff: return disabled frame; zero all weights; stop emitters; release transient render targets; restore no material globals
shutdownPaths.vfxPolicyOff: disable precipitation, lens, ripple, curtain and spray assets; cloud shadow/fog remain consumer-controlled
shutdownPaths.clearWeather: rain-linked weights converge to zero; wetness and puddles follow input rather than weatherId
shutdownPaths.assetOff: set the named asset weight to zero and release only its owned resources
shutdownPaths.qualityFallback: unsupported quality -> Low; unavailable shader/texture -> asset Off; never increase requested quality
shutdownPaths.invalidState: non-finite values use defaults, ranges clamp, zero wind uses default direction
shutdownPaths.dispose: idempotent Stop/Dispose; no scene object destruction outside adapter-owned handles

sourcePolicy.color: sRGB only for visible intensity/color plates
sourcePolicy.masks: derive linear grayscale/alpha; remove black atlas gutters and baked illumination
sourcePolicy.wrap: Clamp until each cell is extracted and proven seamless
sourcePolicy.mobileCompression: ASTC 6x6; lens and ripple masks ASTC 4x4 when validated
sourcePolicy.desktopCompression: BC7 visible plates; BC4 masks where supported
